description.en: The ID of the asset. Fuzzy search is supported.

description.zh: 资产名称，支持模糊搜索。
description.en: The name of the asset. Fuzzy search is supported.

description.zh: 资产类型，精确匹配，不带表示查找所有资产类型。
description.en: The type of the asset for an exact match. If you leave this parameter empty, all asset types are queried.
The page number of the returned page.

description.zh: 查询的结束时间。使用秒级Unix时间戳表示。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The number of the page to return.

description.zh: 端口，精确匹配1-65535，不带表示所有端口。
description.en: The port for an exact match. The value must be an integer from 1 to 65535. If you leave this parameter empty, all ports are queried.

description.zh: 公网IP，精确匹配，不带表示查找所有公网IP。
description.en: The public IP address for an exact match. If you leave this parameter empty, all public IP addresses are queried.

description.zh: 风险等级，不填为全部风险等级。
description.en: The risk level. If you leave this parameter empty, all risk levels are queried.

description.zh: 应用名称，精确匹配，不带表示查找所有应用。
description.en: The name of the application for an exact match. If you leave this parameter empty, all applications are queried.

description.zh: 应用名称，模糊匹配，不带表示查找所有应用。
description.en: The name of the application for a fuzzy match. If you leave this parameter empty, all applications are queried.
The source IP address of the access request.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间。使用秒级Unix时间戳表示。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
